_note: Remediation snippets for the VMOps finding drawer + CVE detail page. Matched most-specific first: exact CVE -> keyword class -> per-OS generic. {CVE} {HOST} {NAME} are substituted at render. 'lang' sets the badge; 'os'/'sev' are optional constraints; 'playbook' is a repo-relative path turned into a clickable link (base: github.com/cloudanimal/remediation-playbooks). Many entries are distilled from real playbooks in that repo - the link points to the full detect/fix/validate/rollback version. Samples - review & test before running.

CVE-2017-0144.title: Disable SMBv1 (MS17-010 / EternalBlue)
script: # {CVE} - {NAME}: remove the legacy SMBv1 protocol (exploited by WannaCry / NotPetya).
# TEST first: confirm nothing on {HOST} still depends on SMBv1 (old NAS, XP/2003).
Get-SmbServerConfiguration | Select-Object EnableSMB1Protocol   # verify, then reboot {HOST}

CVE-2020-1472.title: Zerologon - patch the DC and enforce secure Netlogon RPC
script: # {CVE} - {NAME}: {HOST} is a domain controller. Schedule a maintenance window.
Write-Host 'Patched + enforcement enabled. Reboot {HOST} within the window.'

CVE-2021-26855.title: Exchange ProxyLogon - apply the security update
script: # {CVE} - {NAME}: run from an elevated Exchange Management Shell. Back up first,
# and check {HOST} for prior compromise (webshells) before closing the finding.
Get-Command ExSetup.exe | ForEach-Object { $_.FileVersionInfo.ProductVersion }   # match SU to this build
# Install the matching SU: Start-Process msiexec.exe -Wait -ArgumentList '/update <ExchangeSU>.msp /quiet /norestart'
# Then run the Exchange Health Checker and rescan {HOST}.

CVE-2021-44228.title: Log4Shell - find and remediate vulnerable Log4j 2
script: # {CVE} - {NAME}: the real fix is upgrading log4j-core to >= 2.17.1 (or a vendor patch).
Write-Host 'Flag set. UPGRADE log4j-core to 2.17.1+ - the env var is only a stopgap.'

CVE-2016-2183.title: SWEET32 - disable 3DES / weak Schannel ciphers
script: # {CVE} - {NAME}: disable 3DES and other weak ciphers in Schannel.
# TEST first: ensure clients/partners of {HOST} support AES; very old systems may break.
Write-Host 'Weak ciphers disabled. Reboot {HOST} to apply, then rescan.'

CVE-2022-30190.title: Follina - remove the ms-msdt: protocol handler
script: # {CVE} - {NAME}: remove the ms-msdt: handler (backs up first). The patch is the real fix; this cuts attack surface.
Write-Host "ms-msdt handler removed (backup: $backup). Restore: reg import $backup"

CVE-2023-23397.title: Outlook NTLM leak - disable WebClient + block outbound SMB
script: # {CVE} - {NAME}: cut the NTLM-leak path on {HOST}. Also apply the Outlook security update.
New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'Block outbound SMB to internet (NTLM leak)' -Direction Outbound -Action Block -Protocol TCP -RemotePort 445 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null

CVE-2013-3900.title: WinVerifyTrust - enable Authenticode padding check
script: # {CVE} - {NAME}: the value MUST be a STRING "1" (REG_SZ), not a DWORD - the #1 reason scanners keep flagging it.

class.title: Citrix ADC / Gateway - apply the vendor fix
script: # {CVE} - {NAME}: Citrix ADC / Gateway (NetScaler) is an appliance - remediate via the vendor, not a host script.
show version                       # confirm the current build
# 1) Apply Citrix's published interim mitigation for {CVE} (responder/rewrite policy per the bulletin).
# 2) Upgrade to the fixed build listed in the Citrix advisory, in a maintenance window.
# 3) If SSL-VPN/Gateway was internet-facing, rotate secrets and kill active sessions: kill vpn session -all
# 4) Rescan {HOST} to confirm the fixed build.

class.title: FortiOS / FortiGate - upgrade firmware
script: # {CVE} - {NAME}: FortiGate/FortiOS is an appliance - fix via firmware, from the FortiOS CLI.
get system status                  # confirm the current firmware version
# 1) Find the fixed build in the Fortinet PSIRT advisory for {CVE}.
# 2) Install it (GUI, or via CLI from a TFTP server): execute restore image tftp <fixed-build>.out <tftp-ip>
# 3) Reboot when prompted, then re-check 'get system status'.
# 4) If SSL-VPN was exposed, rotate VPN credentials and review logs for prior access.

class.title: Patch the affected package (Linux)
script: # {CVE} - {NAME}: update the affected package on {HOST} (Linux). Run with sudo.
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade -y <package>
#   sudo dnf upgrade -y <package>      # or: sudo yum update -y <package>
# Verify the fixed version, then restart the affected service (or reboot if it's the kernel/glibc).

script: # {CVE} - {NAME}: no tailored script yet - general Windows patch workflow for {HOST}.

linux.title: Generic patch workflow (Linux)
script: # {CVE} - {NAME}: no tailored script yet - general Linux patch workflow for {HOST}. Run with sudo.
if   command -v apt-get >/dev/null; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get -y upgrade;
elif command -v dnf     >/dev/null; then sudo dnf -y upgrade;
elif command -v yum     >/dev/null; then sudo yum -y update; fi
# Reboot if the kernel or core libraries (glibc/openssl) were updated.
